title: Character sums with log log q outside a sparse set of characters: paper, programs and Lean 4 checks
description: Version 5 of this record: a new paper by Deep Bhattacharjee, amsart, 17 pages, with its LaTeX source, the C and Julia programs that compute the maximal character sums M(χ) for all 5,733,937 nonprincipal characters to prime moduli below 10^4, and a Lean 4 file with the integer arithmetic of the proofs. The paper proves, without hypothesis, that M(χ) ≤ c ε−1 √q log log q for all but O((log q)51 qε) primitive characters modulo q, uniformly in 0 < ε ≤ 1, with a tail bound for every larger threshold, and the analogous statement for L'/L(1, χ). The bound for every character remains open; a zero-free half-plane Re s > θ would give it with a constant of order (1 − θ)−1. Earlier versions of this record contain a different paper.
